war.label: War
war.caption: Illustrated military spending since January 1, {year}
war.methodology: $2.887 trillion: SIPRI’s actual global military expenditure for 2025, used unchanged as an annual benchmark for this {year} illustration. Includes peacetime defence; not measured {year} spending or the cost of wars.

tobacco.label: Tobacco use
tobacco.caption: Illustrated cost of smoking since January 1, {year}
tobacco.methodology: $1.436 trillion annual benchmark for healthcare costs and lost productivity in 2012, published in 2017. Held flat without inflation or growth adjustment; not measured {year} losses or a cash budget.

fossil-fuels.label: Fossil fuels
fossil-fuels.caption: Illustrated fossil-fuel subsidy costs since January 1, {year}
fossil-fuels.methodology: $7.4 trillion annual benchmark for 2024 from IMF Working Paper 2025/270. Includes about $0.7T in explicit subsidies and $6.7T in implicit costs, including externalities and tax underpricing. Not a $7.4T government spending budget or a new {year} estimate.

ai.label: AI
ai.caption: Projected hyperscaler capex since January 1, {year}
ai.methodology: $770 billion for 2026: Epoch AI’s February 2026 projection of all Big-Five hyperscaler capital expenditure (Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle), including finance leases. The AI-only share is unknown; this is not measured AI spending.

food-waste.label: Food wasted
food-waste.caption: Illustrated food loss and waste since January 1, {year}
food-waste.methodology: $936 billion annual product-value benchmark from FAO (2014), in 2012 US dollars, using 2005–2009 food quantities. Held flat without inflation adjustment; not measured {year} losses or fully recoverable cash.

advertising.label: Advertising
advertising.caption: Projected advertising spend since January 1, {year}
advertising.methodology: $1.3 trillion for 2026: WARC’s December 2025 forecast of worldwide advertising expenditure, spread evenly through the year. This is a forecast, not observed spending.

gambling.label: Gambling
gambling.caption: Illustrated gambling losses since January 1, {year}
gambling.methodology: $573 billion: H2 Gambling Capital’s early-2024 forecast of global gross gaming revenue for 2024. Held flat as a historical benchmark; not confirmed {year} losses, total bets or a new forecast.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.counter: Each counter spreads its stated annual estimate evenly across the displayed calendar year in UTC. It is an illustration, not a live measurement. Forecasts, historical benchmarks and economic costs are identified above each counter; they are not interchangeable or additive.
methodology.categories: Each comparison divides the counter by a cited unit cost or funding benchmark. Annual figures show equivalent years of funding, not a promise to solve a problem. Historical estimates retain their original price basis unless an inflation adjustment is explicitly documented; quantities are approximate.
methodology.data: Economic losses and implicit subsidies are not cash budgets that can be fully redirected. These comparisons illustrate scale, not a feasible transfer of funds or guaranteed outcomes. Source notes are in English; all data and calculation code are public.
methodology.repoLabel: View data and source code on GitHub
